result.title: Virtual Task Prompting for Multi-Task Scene Understanding
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables
result.summary: Multi-task scene understanding models typically rely on modified vision encoders or complex decoders for cross-task interaction, which limits their flexibility and compatibility with off-the-shelf vision foundation models (VFMs). We introduce Virtual Task Prompting (VTP), which frames multi-task prompting as retrieving task-adaptive compositions from a shared virtual state, where both the state and routing process are optimized in an end-to-end manner. Concretely, VTP maintains an expanded set of virtual tasks alongside the backbone. At each layer, learnable routing matrices read task-specific compositions as input to interact with image tokens and write the processed results back, forming explicit pathways that capture the intricacies among tasks outside the encoder. Since VTP keeps the backbone clean, it integrates seamlessly with pretrained VFMs, advancing the state of the art on Pascal-Context and NYUD-v2. Stress test on Taskonomy with 13 heterogeneous tasks further shows VTP's robustness in extreme settings. Ablations and analysis indicate that VTP's gains stem from adaptive routing rather than increased capacity. The project page is available at https://jacky1128.github.io/VTP/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Virtual Task Prompting，在视觉主干外维护可扩展的虚拟任务集合，并用逐层可学习路由矩阵从共享虚拟状态读写任务自适应组合，以支持多任务场景理解并兼容预训练视觉基础模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享虚拟状态＋逐层读写路由」可供核查作为 latent 工作区与任务自适应状态更新的方法线索，但论文面向多任务视觉预测而非 VLM 推理，证据筛选与答案使用等联系仍需较多推断。
